'''Selnesh''' was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] supermax [[prison]] facility,<ref name="Rise and Fall" /> located in the [[Selnesh system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> It was later used by the [[New Republic]], where the convicted criminals [[Gapgrin Dozito]] and [[Sart Juloss]] each served 25-[[Standard year|year]] sentences for attempted [[Thief|shipjacking]]. The sentence was listed on the pair's profiles, which were among a number of profiles seen by [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] when she searched for that of the criminal [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14|the mention of Selnesh}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Selnesh was mentioned on a screen in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selnesh/Legends|Selnesh]] first appeared in the short story "[[Do No Harm]]," written by [[Erin Endom]] which was released as part of [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]] in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="Do No Harm">{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm}}</ref>
